newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday through overnight system repurchases, analysts said.

"My numbers show that they've finished their add need for the week, so technically, I could see them staying out, but I might have underestimated the add need, so we could see a small overnight repo today," said Kim Rupert, senior economist at Standard & Poor's MMS International.
"We're looking for overnight or two-day system RPs to replace the temporary reserves that the Fed added on Friday," said Lee Youngdahl, bond market analyst at Aubrey G. Lanston.
The Fed added $3.090 billion in temporary reserves on Friday through over-the-weekend system repurchases.
In mid-morning trade on Monday, Fed funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, the Fed's target for the rate.
